name: GOOSE trip subscriber interface
summary: Maps the assigned received trip message to its defined local control output.
description: Maps the assigned received trip message to its defined local control output. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Subscribed trip event” at the input and “Assigned local trip request” at the output. Authority and quality handling require configuration.
